verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is a code-execution environment rather than an automation builder. Its only related capability is snapshotting: you can save a running sandbox's state and resume or recreate from it later, which allows a coarse point-in-time restore. Auto-persistence on stop preserves the filesystem and configuration, but there is no evidence of version history, diff or review, or explicit rollback of automations. Missing for 10: versioned history of automations or snapshots, review/diff workflow, documented rollback to a prior version, independent corroboration.
